# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For Beacon changes, preserve the application's existing visual style, including rounded controls and theme-aware tabs, dropdown popups, headings, and buttons. Prioritize optimization where justified, and verify unfamiliar APIs/behavior against reputable authoritative sources rather than guessing.
- All text and interaction states must remain legible in dark and light modes; avoid default classic WPF control styling.
- When updating Beacon's README, preserve its existing format and keep the content user-friendly rather than implementation-heavy.
